issues.issue: Phase text says 'Phase 2/3' but is labeled 'Short-term (6-week) Phase 2/3 schizophrenia trial' while trial 2 (041023) is labeled Phase 3; the cited line groups 041004 among six Phase 2/3 trials, so the mixed Phase 2/3 label for a pivotal trial is ambiguous but is citation-supported — minor only.

The result states haloperidol 'superior (p=0.034)' without clarifying it is superior to placebo (active control arm), which could be misread as superiority over asenapine; citation supports superiority to placebo only.
Receipt_date reflects the Feb 13, 2009 complete-response resubmission date rather than the original NDA receipt date; acceptable but potentially misleading as the application's receipt date.
AUTOMATED_FLAG uncited number '5' is a false positive — it is the dose 'asenapine 5 mg bid', not an efficacy figure; the actual efficacy numbers (p=0.007, -14.4, -4.6) are all cited.
AUTOMATED_FLAG uncited number '505' is a false positive — '505(b)' is a statutory reference supported by the receipt_date citation, not an efficacy/safety number.
